letter.title: I also thought an AI agent was just a chatbot with a nice name.
paragraphs: For years I did what every business owner does. I hired, trained, paid payroll taxes, covered absences and redid the work that came back wrong. Every extra real of revenue asked for one more person on payroll. Growing meant having more people to manage.

Then I saw something that changed the math. A single agent taking the request in plain language, breaking it into tasks, calling the right specialist and handing it back done. The copy came from Jonathan. The page went live with Paulo. The lead was qualified on WhatsApp by Davi while I was asleep.

I did not believe it on day one. I tested it in my own business, with my own money and my own clients. What I saw was the work I would pay a whole team for coming out ready, without opening a single new position.
letter.pull: The phenomenon is not AI writing a text. It is a whole team working together, 24 hours a day, without you becoming a people manager.
letter.blocksTitle: Why this turns into recurring revenue

blocks.title: You stop paying payroll to grow
blocks.body: Copy, design, code, ads, support, finance, tax, legal and HR become agents. The bill that went up with every hire stays flat while revenue moves.

blocks.title: You sell what you already use
blocks.body: Every business you serve needs the same team. As an agency, you deliver the agent to your clients and charge every month. Each new client adds to recurring revenue, not to your workload.

blocks.title: The R$ 100k math works without a team
blocks.body: High recurring revenue does not come from one giant client. It comes from many clients paying every month for a service that runs by itself. The agents handle delivery, you handle sales.

letter.closing: I will not ask you to believe me. I will show you the team at work, what each role costs when done by people and who is already using it. Then you decide.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
items: Do I need to know how to code?
No. You talk to Naia in plain language, in the panel or on Telegram, and she coordinates the rest. Every screen of the panel has a step by step.
What is the difference between having the agent and being an agency?
With the agent, you use the team in your own business. As an agency, you deliver agents to your clients and build a portfolio that pays every month.
Is each client's data kept apart from the others?
Yes. Each client has their own agent, their own memory and their own password vault, isolated from everyone else.
It depends on the size of the operation and the path you choose. Fill in the form and the team will present the right proposal for you.
Does the panel work in other languages?
Yes. The panel works in Portuguese, English and Spanish.
How do I talk to the team?
Fill in one of the forms on this page. The team answers on the WhatsApp number you provide.
